text: ‘Globalisation has led to greater equality between countries.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Global migration makes developing countries poorer.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘The media has a direct influence on social behaviour.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Governments lack the power to control media content.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religion is a means by which the ruling class maintain social control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religious organisations have lost their social significance.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
